quests.title: The Skipped Hour

find.text: On the meditation platform a sun-dial's gnomon has been filed to a stub, and beneath it a note in a careful hand: 'Count the bells at dusk. There are twenty-three. Which hour was taken?'

quests.desc: A filed-down sundial on a meditation isle says Alinor's bells chime only twenty-three hours.
quests.pitch: A hermit on the Isle of Contemplation insists that one bell of the day is missing, and has been for sixty years.

objectives.text: Take a rubbing of the grey tile from the Colosseum to the capital's clock-square.
Find the bell-ringer's warding-word in Alinor's clock tower.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The missing hour is traced through an old arena, the capital and a vault of false doors to the tower of crystal and the Psijics' rearranging vault.

quests.title: The Skipped Hour (II)
quests.desc: The missing hour is traced through an old arena, the capital and a vault of false doors to the tower of crystal and the Psijics' rearranging vault.
quests.pitch: A hermit on the Isle of Contemplation insists that one bell of the day is missing, and has been for sixty years.

objectives.text: Break the wall behind the false doors and retrieve the brick.
Remove the cloth from the lens at the tower's summit and look through.
Find the room that is no longer anywhere and take the candle.

quests.outro: I stepped through the last door into a room that was lit by a single candle and an hour long gone. Someone had killed a man in that hour, and the Order had folded it away. I walked out carrying its name.

quests.title: The Glass Fever

find.text: A bluff-top grave is covered in a fine scatter of crystal splinters, glinting in the grass. A small wooden marker reads only: 'Glass-fevered. Do not dig.'

quests.desc: A glinting grave on a bluff marked 'Glass-fevered. Do not dig.' and a scatter of crystal splinters.
quests.pitch: A woman at Dawnbreak says her husband's eyes glittered like cut glass before he walked into the bluff.

objectives.text: Take the cider sample from Mara's Kiss and trace the apples to Shattered Grove.
Take a grove-shard to the tidal port of Firsthold to match its resonance.
Take the quarantine list from Firsthold to the star-ring hill of Skywatch.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The fever's spread runs through a tavern, a splintered grove and a tide-island to the star-ringed hill, a prison and the red fortress.

quests.title: The Glass Fever (II)
quests.desc: The fever's spread runs through a tavern, a splintered grove and a tide-island to the star-ringed hill, a prison and the red fortress.
quests.pitch: A woman at Dawnbreak says her husband's eyes glittered like cut glass before he walked into the bluff.

objectives.text: Re-true the orrery at Skywatch and learn the cult's bearing.
Free the cells' refusers and take their testimony to the red fortress.
Break the seed-crystal at the heart of the red fortress.

quests.outro: At the red fortress's heart I broke the seed-crystal and the splinters in every vein of Auridon dimmed, one by one. The glass-fevered will take years to recover, but they will.

quests.title: The Egg-Tithe

find.text: An orchard-keep's accounts list 'egg-tithe, forwarded to the steward at Cloudrest': thirty clutches in each of five seasons, and none in the sixth. 'The gryphons stopped,' it adds. 'Or were stopped.'

quests.desc: An orchard-keep's ledger lists an egg-tithe forwarded to a steward and a sixth season where no clutch came.
quests.pitch: The orchard-keep's reeve says no gryphon has hatched on the coast this spring.

objectives.text: Follow the dealer's crate from the Golden Netch to the port of Shimmerene.
Raid the quiet quay at Shimmerene and take the stolen clutch back to its aerie.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The trail goes from a balloon-inn and a dock to the aerie, the palace of balconies and a lightning-rod fortress.

quests.title: The Egg-Tithe (II)
quests.desc: The trail goes from a balloon-inn and a dock to the aerie, the palace of balconies and a lightning-rod fortress.
quests.pitch: The orchard-keep's reeve says no gryphon has hatched on the coast this spring.

objectives.text: Return the clutch to the aerie and carry the mother's thread of song to Cloudrest.
Open the steward's strongbox under Cloudrest and take the ledger.
Hatch the clutch in Tor Hame Khard's warm court and sing the palace back to strength.

quests.outro: I returned the clutch to the aerie and heard, far above, a single clear note. The balconies of Cloudrest steadied. The steward will have a great deal to explain to the court.

quests.title: The Silk Library

find.text: A monastery urn is full of silk-thread spools, each wound around a tiny rolled slip with a word. A monk has tagged them: 'These are the library's lost books. Please do not eat them.'

quests.desc: An urn of silk-thread spools at a monastery, each wound around a rolled slip with a single word.
quests.pitch: The Trebbite monks found silk with words in it and have no idea how it got there.

objectives.text: Take the blank book from Dusk to the library city of Lillandril.
Find the missing librarian's last catalogue entry and follow its bearing.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The lost words lead through a dune port and the great library to an acropolis and a vault wrapped in webs.

quests.title: The Silk Library (II)
quests.desc: The lost words lead through a dune port and the great library to an acropolis and a vault wrapped in webs.
quests.pitch: The Trebbite monks found silk with words in it and have no idea how it got there.

objectives.text: Take a silk-page from the acropolis to the vault wrapped in webs.
Listen to the librarian's reading and decide what to do about the Loom-Mother.

quests.outro: I found the librarian at a silk-lectern, reading aloud to a roomful of patient spiders. She did not look up. I sat down and listened until the afternoon had gone.
